description:
ARA is a Java 21 framework for building autonomous AI agents and multi-agent systems
        on the JVM. It combines LLM integration, tool calling, deterministic I/O contracts,
        multi-agent orchestration, RAG and human-in-the-loop flows in a clean, interface-first
        architecture — no annotation magic, no reflection, no Spring, no Kotlin, no framework
        lock-in. Published to Maven Central as io.github.xmor:ara-core, ara-runtime and
        ara-adapters.
